name: Pokémon Platinum
notes: Base-game pack. Encounter pools generated from PokéAPI data, merged to location level across sub-areas, encounter methods, and the paired versions (in-game trades and raid/event distributions excluded); area order is estimated from encounter levels and is approximate. First-battle teams for Pokémon Platinum. Gym order differs from D/P: Fantina is 3rd, Maylene 4th, Crasher Wake 5th. Bertha's ace is Rhyperior Lv 55 (some guides mislabel Hippowdon, which is Lv 52 here). Platinum Elite Four first-battle levels verified against the Platinum trainer-data dump and Bulbapedia-derived tables; post-National-Dex rematch teams (Lv 65+) are NOT included.
